data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Ash Sha'a', meaning 'Noble, Valiant'. This name is perfect for a child who is destined to become a great leader, a powerful and courageous individual who will be remembered throughout history. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ashaz usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, valiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It is a reminder of the inner power that each of us possesses, and a call to tap into that power in times of need. This name is also a symbol of nobility, reminding us to strive for greatness and to uphold the highest moral values.
